body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> ViewSonic presented ''ViewDock (model: VX2245wm)’ 22-inch monitor equipped with iPod docking station during KES 2006. Users can enjoy music or video-clips or transmit data from iPod easily by placing it on the dock. The monitor includes 4 USB ports and 8-in-1 media card reader and iPod charger while internal stereo speaker and subwoofer help to offer powerful sound. It is expected to be available in Korean market in November.
